model2.bytedance_note: Doubao and Jimeng render with one ByteDance model family; the class names that shared generator lineage. Measured 2026-09-07 on the frozen test cell: 83.9% (271/323), extended with the historical harvest 83.6% (529/633).
model2.tc260_note: the head covers the REST of China's generator ecosystem -- producers (Qwen, Yuanbao, Kling, ...) that are peers of openai/google/meta, not one vendor. No mixed head can honestly name the group, so its argmax win abstains (provider=None). Measured 2026-09-07: without the veto 207/379 China test rows would be falsely named openai/google/muse-image. Per-producer classes return when their train mass holds their own cells (qwen measured at 64 train rows: 27% -- stays in the fallback).
model2.snapshot_tolerance: provider.pt snapshots predating bytedance load with five heads; absent heads are skipped and their rows fall to the tc260 veto

receipt_gate.head: linear on the CLIP-L-ft 768-d vector Model 1 already computes
receipt_gate.train: CORD-v2 train 800 (CC BY 4.0) + 200 synthetic receipts + 2400 ai_train negatives
receipt_gate.certified: min of 1st-percentile scores on CORD validation and a synthetic holdout; no field-receipt pixels in training or threshold selection
receipt_gate.measured: field receipts false-AI 19/59 -> 2/59; CORD 89/99 -> 0/99; ai_test DEFINITELY cost 7/1847
